description: This file declares interfaces and data structures related to a request throttling mechanism in the lighttpd server, including functions for creating, configuring, updating, and managing throttle states and pools.

methods.name: li_throttle_new
methods.description: Creates a new throttle state object.

methods.name: li_throttle_set
methods.description: Configures the throttle with specified rate and burst parameters.

methods.name: li_throttle_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a throttle state.

methods.name: li_throttle_query
methods.description: Queries the throttle state to determine availability and possibly registers a notification callback.

methods.name: li_throttle_update
methods.description: Updates throttle state based on used resources.

methods.name: li_throttle_pool_acquire
methods.description: Acquires resources from a throttle pool.

methods.name: li_throttle_pool_release
methods.description: Releases resources back to a throttle pool.

methods.name: li_throttle_add_pool
methods.description: Adds a throttle pool to a worker’s throttle management.

methods.name: li_throttle_remove_pool
methods.description: Removes a throttle pool from a worker’s throttle management.

methods.name: li_throttle_waitqueue_cb
methods.description: Internal callback used during worker waitqueue setup.
